estimate.damage_summary: During a swerve while travelling in a car, the laptop was thrown against the car door; the screen cracked and the lower-right housing was damaged. The invoice also includes polishing of an explicitly pre-existing lid scuff and a diagnostic inspection.
estimate.policy_notes: The portable-equipment peril covers sudden external impact, including equipment displaced inside a conveyance. The described event and damage pattern appear consistent with cover, assuming the schedule shows the peril and household contents as agreed; no schedule or deductible details were supplied. The old scuff polish is excluded as pre-existing cosmetic work. Necessary diagnostics are covered following an insured event, subject to the EUR 250 including VAT per-event cap. No battery-capacity finding is provided to trigger the end-of-working-life provision.

lines.rationale: The cracked screen is expressly part of the reported impact damage, and replacement of the display assembly is a plausible repair. The threshold allows for a standard equivalent display assembly and fitting, not an upgrade.

The lower-right corner and housing damage are expressly attributed to the same impact, and replacing the damaged lower housing shell is a plausible repair. One housing repair is justified; the price range allows for the shell and fitting.

lines.invoice_text: Polish of pre-existing lid scuff (surface only, does not affect operation)
lines.rationale: The invoice identifies this as a pre-existing surface scuff, not damage caused by the insured impact. The work is cosmetic and is excluded even if carried out alongside covered repairs; the price estimate is for valuation purposes only.

A diagnostic inspection to establish the damage and scope of repair is an expressly covered cost after an insured portable-equipment event. One inspection is plausible; the reasonable amount is assessed below the EUR 250 including VAT per-event cap.
